unit.why: A single hagiographic narrative about R. Aryeh Leibush of Łańcut. It follows him from his reading of the Maggid of Kozienice's Etz Hayyim, through the Maggid's prediction and his appointment by the Apter Rav, to the Apter's praises of him.

stories.start_quote: מהגה"ק ר׳ ארי׳ ליבוש זצ"ל אבד״ק לאנצוט וקעשינוב
stories.summary_en: As a young man, R. Aryeh Leibush visits the Maggid of Kozienice and, against the Maggid's rule, reads his Etz Hayyim. He grasps a deep secret marked in the margin, so the Maggid foretells his greatness; later the Apter Rav appoints him rabbi of Kreshinov and praises him as the one to whom the Torah's hidden secrets were revealed.

quotes: נסע להסתופף בצל המגיד הגה״ק מקאזניץ ז"ל
tags.why: He journeys to the Maggid's court.

quotes: הקפיד שלא יעיין שום אדם בספריו
tags.why: The Maggid's ban on reading his books, which the young man breaks.

quotes: ופתח את הספר עץ חיים אשר למד
tags.why: He opens the Maggid's book despite the ban.

quotes: בכאן יש סוד גדול עמוק מי ימצאנו
tags.why: Kabbalistic secrets of Etz Hayyim and the hidden secrets of the Torah.
He reads the Maggid's private annotated copy of a Lurianic text.

quotes: והרגיש בו באיזה מקום עיין האברך
tags.why: The Maggid senses which passage he read.

quotes: מבטחני בו שיגדל בתורה ויפיץ ענן אורו
tags.why: The Maggid predicts his greatness, and it comes true.
The young man's hidden greatness is revealed to the masters and the public.
The Maggid realizes the youth's stature.
Praise of the tsaddik's spiritual stature.

quotes: בא לקעשינוב כמנהגו מדי שנה בשנה ויתאכסן
tags.why: The Apter Rav travels each year and lodges in Kreshinov.
The Apter's praise is spoken at the Sabbath table.

quotes: קבלו אותו לר״מ בכבוד ושמחה רבה
tags.why: He is installed as communal rabbi, not as rebbe.
Relations among the Maggid, the Apter Rav and R. Aryeh Leibush.
